mcqs.question: Which of the following is the correct order of installing components during computer assembly?
options: SMPS, Motherboard, Processor, RAM, Storage Devices
Motherboard, Processor, SMPS, RAM, Storage Devices
Processor, Motherboard, SMPS, RAM, Storage Devices
SMPS, Processor, Motherboard, RAM, Storage Devices
mcqs.answer: SMPS, Motherboard, Processor, RAM, Storage Devices

mcqs.question: Which of the following is NOT a step in assembling a computer system?
options: Installation of SMPS
Installation of Motherboard
Installation of CPU Heat Sink and Fan
Installation of a refrigerator

mcqs.question: What is the primary function of the power supply unit (SMPS) in a computer system?
options: To provide cooling to the CPU
To provide power to all components of the system
To store data in the hard disk drive
To connect peripherals to the system
mcqs.answer: To provide power to all components of the system

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a characteristic of a properly assembled computer system?
options: Efficient performance, reliability, and ease of maintenance
Inefficient performance, unreliability, and difficulty in maintenance
High power consumption, low reliability, and ease of maintenance
Low power consumption, high reliability, and difficulty in maintenance
mcqs.answer: Efficient performance, reliability, and ease of maintenance

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a type of interface used to connect storage devices to the motherboard?
options: SATA
PCIe
All of the above

mcqs.question: What is the purpose of the CPU cooling fan/heat sink in a computer system?
options: To provide power to the CPU
To store data in the hard disk drive
To dissipate heat generated by the CPU
To connect peripherals to the system
mcqs.answer: To dissipate heat generated by the CPU

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a type of expansion slot used in a computer system?
options: PCIe
SATA
All of the above

mcqs.question: What is the primary function of the BIOS/UEFI in a computer system?
options: To provide power to the CPU
To store data in the hard disk drive
To check hardware during startup
To connect peripherals to the system

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a type of cable used to connect peripherals to the system?
options: USB
PS/2
VGA
All of the above

mcqs.question: What is the purpose of the power connections in a computer system?
options: To provide power to the CPU
To store data in the hard disk drive
To connect peripherals to the system
To provide power to all components of the system
mcqs.answer: To provide power to all components of the system

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a type of storage device used in a computer system?
options: Hard Disk Drive (HDD)
Solid State Drive (SSD)
Flash Drive
All of the above

mcqs.question: What is the primary function of the motherboard in a computer system?
options: To provide power to the CPU
To store data in the hard disk drive
To connect peripherals to the system
To serve as the main circuit board that connects all components
mcqs.answer: To serve as the main circuit board that connects all components
